steps: Join Greater Nevada Credit Union as a new member and open a Regular Share Savings account plus your first Aspire, Cash Back, or Connect checking account — request promo code GNCU250 at opening ($5 application fee, $5 minimum savings balance).
Within 60 days of opening, receive at least one direct deposit into the checking account.
Within the same 60 days, enroll in Digital Banking and eStatements, and keep your accounts in good standing.
The $250 bonus is paid during the first two weeks of the third calendar month after opening. Nevada eligibility: live or work in any of Nevada's 17 counties, plus immediate family.
